question.subtext: If a payment doesn’t appear immediately, it may be pending, delayed by the bank, or under review.

bullet-points: Check your Transaction History.
Verify the recipient details (account number, bank, etc.).
Confirm your wallet was funded before sending.
Some transfers may take up to 10 – 30 minutes depending on the method.

question.subtext: We understand how important it is for your funds to arrive on time. If your transaction hasn’t been received, here are a few possible reasons and what you can do:

bullet-points: Go to Transactions from your dashboard
Tap the specific transaction to view its status - in progress, pending, completed or failed.
In progress: We’re confirming with partner banks
Pending: Your transfer is still processing
Completed: The funds have been sent
Failed: The transfer didn’t go through (check for refund)
If you used Interac e-Transfer or bank transfer, double-check that the funds were actually sent from your bank.
You may have received confirmation from your bank or from us.
Bank transfers or Interac e-Transfers can take 10–30 minutes depending on the bank.

name: How to fund my wallet (CAD / NGN)

question.header: How to fund my wallet (CAD / NGN)
question.subtext: You can add funds to your wallet easily.

bullet-points: Log in to the app.
Select Add within the Wallet you want to fund.
Follow the on-screen instructions for payment (Interac e-transfer, bank transfer, etc.).Note: We do not accept third-party deposits.

name: Withdrawing money to my bank account

question.header: Withdrawing money to my bank account

bullet-points: Log in to the app.
Select Send within the Wallet you want to withdraw from
Enter your Interac details for CAD/recipient’s details or your Naira bank details/recipient’s details for NGN or choose from saved beneficiaries.
Follow the on-screen instructions to enter amount to send
Confirm the transaction.
Enter your transaction PIN
Insufficient wallet balance.
Invalid recipient details.
Daily transaction limits.
Network or bank delays.
Double-check the recipient info.
Make sure you haven’t exceeded limits.
If funds were deducted but not delivered, contact support.
